name: factor into orthogonal times triangular, remultiply in reverse order, repeat
mechanism: factor the matrix as an orthogonal factor times an upper-triangular factor, multiply them back in the opposite order to get a similar matrix, and repeat; the sub-diagonal decays and the eigenvalues appear on the diagonal (shifts and deflation accelerate it)

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'QR algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra:

fails_when: cubic per iteration without a preliminary reduction to compact form
